summary: Applies lower and upper constraints to selected attributes by clamping, looping, or zig-zagging values, with optional positive-only output, type casting, and quantization. Parameter Size allows separate control per component.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Optional group limiting which elements are affected

key_params.name: inputattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute or components to limit

key_params.name: parsize
key_params.note: Number of independent component parameter lanes

key_params.name: mintype
key_params.note: Minimum behavior: off, clamp, loop, or zig zag

key_params.name: maxtype
key_params.note: Maximum behavior: off, clamp, loop, or zig zag

key_params.name: attrtype
key_params.note: Output data type when overriding automatic typing

key_params.name: attrdefaultval
key_params.note: Default output value if limiting cannot be computed

key_concepts: Limit POP constrains selected attributes by applying minimum and maximum behavior independently.
Minimum and maximum modes can clamp, loop, or zig-zag values, so the operator can bound or wrap attributes without extra math nodes.
Positive-only, cast, output-attribute, and quantize controls let Limit POP finish a value-shaping chain in one operator.
common_gotchas: Set Parameter Size to match the scoped components when RGB, UV, or vector channels need independent limits.
Loop and zig-zag are wrapping operations, not hard clamps; choose clamp for physical bounds.
Math Mix or Math Combine may be better for formulas that combine limiting with other arithmetic.
